items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: One time I was on the stage with Jimmy Jones on piano and John Levy on bass.

ctx.x: When did it become let’s say acceptable to mix racially in the groups in New York City? Was there ever a problem for you?

Not that I know of. I have been playing with black and white musicians all my life. I started, and I have pictures to prove it, I’ll show them to you. One time I was on the stage with Jimmy Jones on piano and John Levy on bass. I’ll show you the pictures. Tim are those gentlemen still outside? See if they’re outside please. I never had a problem. I played on the stage with Sidney Bechet. I played on the stage with Wilbur DeParis, Sidney DeParis, J.C. Higginbotham. Didn’t bother me. I know Benny Goodman had a…
Maybe you should make a call down to the front desk.
